title: Testing the Blog System
excerpt: This is just a test post to see if everything’s working. Spoiler: it is. 😎
content:
Today I tested my new blog system — built entirely with flat JSON files hosted on GitHub Pages, and rendered with custom PHP on my site.

It's clean, lightweight, and 100% mine.

Here's to publishing without pushing code every time. 💻✨

Next step? Maybe a GitHub API connection so I can hit 'Publish' right from my site. Let's get it.

✌🏻 - Ryan
